global_principles.statement: Categorize the screenshot according to the primary object/purpose represented by the screenshot, not merely any topic mentioned inside it.
application_rules: Communication vs Topic: If the primary layout is an email thread, chat UI, or inbox list (headers 'From:', 'Subject:', reply buttons, chat bubbles), classify as Communication even if the body text discusses jobs, courses, or products.

Shopping vs Payment: Product catalogs, product detail pages, and carts with 'Add to cart' or 'Buy now' belong to Shopping. Completed transaction confirmation receipts with 'Transaction ID', 'UPI Ref', or 'Payment Successful' belong to Payment.

Education vs Work: Course syllabi, lecture slides, academic quizzes, and textbook pages belong to Education. Job vacancy postings, resumes, recruiter outreach, and workplace management dashboards belong to Work & Career.

Coding vs Text: IDEs, developer terminals, raw source code blocks, and compiler tracebacks belong to Coding. Text articles merely mentioning programming concepts without code layout belong to Education or General.

Communication.primary_purpose: Direct messaging, email threads, chat conversations, and social comment threads.
exclusion_conditions: Standalone payment receipt without email/chat frame
Communication.tie_breaking_rules: If email/chat frame is dominant and intent is messaging, choose Communication over embedded body topic.
Communication.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators with chat/email frame.

Work & Career.primary_purpose: Job listings, career applications, recruitment, resumes, professional workplace dashboards, and corporate management.
exclusion_conditions: Academic university course syllabus or assignment
Work & Career.tie_breaking_rules: If the primary view is a job posting or applicant tracking page, choose Work & Career over Education or General.
Work & Career.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators.

Shopping.primary_purpose: E-commerce product listings, shopping carts, product detail pages, and retail catalogs.
exclusion_conditions: Completed bank transaction receipt (belongs to Payment)
Shopping.tie_breaking_rules: If the screen shows purchase intent before checkout ('Add to cart', 'Buy now'), choose Shopping over Payment.
Shopping.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators with price/cart context.

Payment.primary_purpose: Digital payment confirmations, receipts, invoices, bank transfers, and UPI transaction status screens.
exclusion_conditions: Generic price listing without transaction proof
Payment.tie_breaking_rules: If transaction completion status or banking reference number is present, choose Payment over Shopping.
Payment.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators with transaction status.

Education.primary_purpose: Academic course material, lecture slides, textbooks, study notes, flashcards, exams, and educational quizzes.
exclusion_conditions: Raw source code editor or IDE terminal view (belongs to Coding)
Education.tie_breaking_rules: If content is academic or tutorial material explaining concepts, choose Education over Work & Career.
Education.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators.

Coding.primary_purpose: Source code editors, IDE interfaces, developer terminals, git commits, compiler errors, and code tracebacks.
exclusion_conditions: Textbook prose discussing coding conceptually without code syntax/editor layout
Coding.tie_breaking_rules: If code syntax, IDE controls, terminal traceback, or git operations are visible, choose Coding over Education.
Coding.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators with code syntax.

Travel.primary_purpose: Flight tickets, airline bookings, boarding passes, hotel reservations, train/bus tickets, and travel itineraries.
exclusion_conditions: Generic city news or map screenshot without booking/ticket data
Travel.tie_breaking_rules: If screen displays ticket/PNR itinerary details, choose Travel over Payment or Communication.
Travel.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators.

Connectivity.primary_purpose: Network configuration, Wi-Fi settings, Bluetooth pairing, IP/MAC addresses, and connection status.
exclusion_conditions: Generic phone system settings without network configuration
Connectivity.tie_breaking_rules: If screen is network/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth setup, choose Connectivity over General.
Connectivity.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators.

Entertainment.primary_purpose: Video streaming, music playback, media player libraries, gaming, movies, and entertainment media.
exclusion_conditions: Product ad video in shopping app
Entertainment.tie_breaking_rules: If media player controls or music/movie streaming UI is visible, choose Entertainment over General.
Entertainment.minimum_evidence_requirement: At least 1 strong positive indicator OR 2 supporting indicators.

General.primary_purpose: Default fallback for smartphone home screens, clock, calculator, weather, and unclassified screenshots.
exclusion_conditions: Any screenshot containing strong positive indicators for a domain category
General.tie_breaking_rules: General is chosen only when no domain category meets its minimum positive evidence requirement or domain evidence is penalized.
General.minimum_evidence_requirement: Fallback default when domain positive evidence score is zero or penalized.
